fullDescription: A cinematic, high-density 'Mission Control' style guide inspired by award-winning data-driven interfaces. Features a deep canvas background (#050505) with neon #2BFF57 accents and red/orange severity indicators. The design centers on ultra-extended typography (Archivo), industrial hairline grids (rgba 255,255,255,0.08), and a 'Meridian' style cursor-following spotlight effect. Suitable for logistics, fintech monitoring, command centers, and industrial IoT dashboards requiring real-time data visibility with a high-end, futuristic aesthetic.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-performance command center dashboard featuring ultra-extended display typography, hairline grid structures, and a cinematic spotlight cursor interaction. The layout uses a strict hierarchy of data from massive KPI numerals to dense, mono-spaced micro-logs, all tied together with a neon green accent color and smooth expo-easing animations.

## Estilo Visual
### Visual Foundation
- **Canvas**: Solid #050505 background.
- **Accents**: Neon Green (#2BFF57) for primary data and active states; use shadow-glows (0_0_12px_rgba(43,255,87,0.6)).
- **Grid**: 1px borders using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` across all containers.

### Typography System
- **Extended Display**: Archivo (font-stretch: 125%, letter-spacing: -0.04em, uppercase). Use for giant wordmarks (10vw) and section numbers.
- **Interface**: Plus Jakarta Sans for body text and labels.
- **Data Mono**: JetBrains Mono (weight 400/500) for all technical values, logs, and system timestamps.
- **Micro-Labels**: Font-size 9px, weight 600, 0.2em letter-spacing, uppercase, 40% opacity.

### Motion & Interactions
- **Entrance**: Staggered fade-up using `cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1)` over 0.8s.
- **Spotlight**: A radial-gradient cursor follower (circle 300px) that reveals text color from rgba(255,255,255,0.1) to 0.9.
- **Ticker**: A continuous 40s linear marquee for system alerts.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header & Masthead
Create a masthead band (pt-12, pb-4) with a top utility bar containing a system status indicator (blinking green dot) and a right-aligned user/nav rail. Below this, place a viewport-wide wordmark 'MISSION CONTROL' in 10vw Archivo Extended. Implement a cursor-following radial mask where the text is only fully bright (#FFF) within 200px of the mouse, fading to 10% opacity elsewhere.

### Alert Marquee Ticker
Position a thin full-width marquee directly under the header. Use `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)` background and hairline borders. Populate with `[CRITICAL]`, `[WARNING]`, and `[SYSTEM]` snippets in 9px JetBrains Mono, scrolling infinitely at a 40s cycle.

### KPI Grid
A 6-column grid of equal-width cells separated by hairline borders. Each cell includes: Top-left '01 — LABEL', Top-right mono-spaced ID, Center-left massive 8xl scale Archivo Extended numeral (thin weight), and a bottom-aligned status micro-label colored by severity (Red/Green/Orange).

### Facility Monitoring Board (60% Width)
The primary dashboard area. Section header uses '01 SECTION_NAME' in 5xl Archivo Extended. Below it, list alert cards. Each card is separated by a bottom hairline, has a 1.5px vertical status-bar on the extreme left (colored by severity with a matching glow), a circular index marker (01, 02...), a facility name in 2xl Extended type, and a large FPI score (3xl) on the right.

### Intelligence Rail (40% Width)
A dense vertical rail for deep-dive data. Top section features a 'Selected System' profile with a 2x2 data grid of performance metrics (mono font). Mid-section contains 'OPS_LOGS' with a left-accented border in #2BFF57. Bottom section 'INTEL' features high-contrast cards for external environmental factors with hover-state border color changes.

### Utility Footer
A fixed 12px height footer in solid #000. Left side displays active stream timestamps with a pulsing #2BFF57 indicator. Right side shows refresh cycles and system status in 8px micro-labels.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Cinematic KPI Card — A high-impact data visualization component for critical metrics.
Structure a card within a hairline grid. Set the primary number in Archivo Extended at 8xl size, font-weight 100. Place a numbered micro-label (e.g., '01 — STRESSED') in the top-left using 0.2em tracking. Add a sub-context label at the bottom (e.g., '3 CRITICAL_ERR') using neon green or error red. Background should transition to 1% white opacity on hover.

### Severity Indicator Rail — Vertical highlight for data rows showing status importance.
A 1.5px wide by 48px tall vertical bar positioned on the absolute left of a list item. For 'Critical' status, use #EF4444 with a CSS box-shadow: 4px 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,0.5). For 'Warning', use #F97316 with 60% opacity and no glow.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain strict uppercase for all display and micro-label text. MUST NOT use rounded corners on structural containers (only icons and pills). MUST use expo-easing for all animations to avoid 'cheap' linear movement. DO ensure all numbers use JetBrains Mono or Archivo Extended for a technical feel.

style.description: The style is 'Industrial Cinematic.' It utilizes a pitch-black background (#050505) and a limited but vibrant palette: Neon Green (#2BFF57), Error Red (#EF4444), and Warning Orange (#F97316). Typography is the core element: Archivo with 125% stretch for massive display headlines, JetBrains Mono for data points, and Plus Jakarta Sans for UI elements. Layout elements are separated by 1px hairline borders (rgba 255,255,255,0.08). Animation follows a staggered entrance pattern using cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) to feel premium and technical.
